name: year
observations: Partition column. Collection year of the quarter file, not the BLS release year

name: quarter
description: Quarter the data was collected, from 1 to 4

name: consumer_unit_id
description: Identifier of the consumer unit (household), stable across its interviews or diary weeks

name: diary_week
description: Diary week of the consumer unit, 1 or 2

name: newid
description: BLS public-use identifier of the consumer unit and interview or diary week; the last digit is the interview number (1-4) or diary week (1-2)
observations: Unique per interview or diary week

name: amount_
description: Data-quality flag for AMOUNT: valid, blank, allocated, imputed or topcoded
observations: Flag codes A-W are listed in dicionario and in the BLS Getting Started Guide

name: pub_flag
description: Is amount included in published reports?
